import json, itertools, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'nuvem'))
from benchmark import solver_bridge as bridge
m=bridge.engine()
s=json.loads((root/'docs/checkpoints/evidence/beta-cache-off-tp1.json').read_text())
data=json.loads((root/'nuvem/benchmark/projects/torre_easy_lo_r00_tp1/input.json').read_text())
nodes,walls,ends,openings=bridge.plan_from_input(data)
catalog,_,_=bridge.catalog_from_input(data)
pcs=s['candidates']
for c in pcs:
 for k in ('origin_world','x_dir','y_dir'):c[k]=m.XYZ(*c[k])
 c['cells_world']=m._make_block_candidate(c['logical_code'],catalog[c['logical_code']],c['course'],c['origin_world'],c['x_dir'],c['placement_reason'])['cells_world']
rows={int(ci):[pcs[i] for i in r['candidates']] for ci,r in s['physical'].items()}
p0,_,axis,_,_=m._wall_axis_and_length(walls,40)
def target(c):
 if c.get('wall_idx')!=40 or c.get('placement_reason')!='STANDARD_FILL':return False
 lo,hi=m._candidate_extent_on_wall_axis(c,p0,axis)
 return lo>=35-1e-6 and hi<=219+1e-6
codes=['B39']*4+['C09']*2+['C04']
for ci,row in rows.items():
 if ci%2==0:assert sorted(c['logical_code'] for c in row if target(c))==sorted(codes),(ci,[c['logical_code'] for c in row if target(c)])
results=[]
for order in sorted(set(itertools.permutations(codes))):
 cursor=35.0;layout=[];new=[]
 for code in order:
  length=catalog[code]['length_cm']
  layout.append((code,cursor,cursor+length))
  new.append(m._make_block_candidate(code,catalog[code],'A',p0+axis*bridge._ft(cursor+length/2),axis,'STANDARD_FILL',wall_idx=40))
  cursor+=length+1
 assert abs(cursor-220)<1e-6
 test={ci:[c for c in row if not target(c)]+new if ci%2==0 else row for ci,row in rows.items()}
 audit=m.audit_wall_bond_quality(40,walls,test,catalog,len(rows),openings_per_wall=openings,nodes=nodes,end_to_node=ends)
 results.append({'order':order,'adjacency_excess':m._layout_compensator_run_excess(layout,catalog),'continuous_joints':len(audit['continuous_joints']),'compensator_strips':len(audit['compensator_strips']),'audit_ok':audit['ok']})
eligible=[r for r in results if r['adjacency_excess']==0]
summary={'permutations':len(results),'nonadjacent':len(eligible),'nonadjacent_audit_ok':sum(r['audit_ok'] for r in eligible),'minimum_strips_without_adjacency':min(r['compensator_strips'] for r in eligible),'minimum_continuous_joints_without_adjacency':min(r['continuous_joints'] for r in eligible)}
payload={'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'input_sha256':s['input_sha256'],'wall_key':s['wall_keys'][40],'span_cm':[35,219],'scope':'All permutations of the existing seven-piece multiset on all even physical courses, fixed nodes/boundaries, odd rows untouched. No solver patch or normative relaxation. Not an exhaustive composition or global topology search.','summary':summary,'alternatives':results}
with (root/'docs/checkpoints/evidence/beta-wall40-orders.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(payload,f,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(summary))
